notes.title: Halloween Update - Chapter 2
notes.content:
- More work fixing chapter 2 and preparing it for release. 

I'd say we're about 70% of the way to releasing chapter 2 and the story's really coming together. 

- Added Jeremy and Susie's appearances on Chapter 2

- Substances found in the morgue fully functional now.

- More work on ENVY and LIBIDO for Archty.

- Dialogs for Nurse Betty completed, no voiceover yet.

- Voiceover for letters and notes added.

- Archty's deep psychosis Maze added to Chapter 2, with his memories of Chapter 1, including his lovely mother Emily.

- Flashlight functional and available

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
We're still working hard on chapter 2 and everyone is invited to check it out, just contact us on mundiproject@hotmail.com

On this update, we added several loading screens that explain a lot about the emotions and game mechanics. They will improve your experience and help you understand more about what's going on in Archty's mind. 
--
Feel free to follow us on our newest social accounts, to keep up to track for what else is to come from us!
http://twitter.com/themundiproject
http://themundiprojectgamestudio.tumblr.com

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
On today's update:

- no more audio on 911 call. Matter settled and all topics related to this deleted, since it's not a feature anymore.

- some glitches with colliders that made player fall through the floor fixed.

- no more Ghostbusters, you can now try to call your therapist.

- now, you can find a medical file that describes what triggers Archty's psychosis.
